title: Dominic and the Orchard
author: Oscar Iversen
blurb: Cyrus Delacroix, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
